products.name: Immersive Venue Experiences (Sphere)
products.description: Operation of large-scale, technologically advanced venues (Sphere) that host immersive experiences, concerts, residencies, sporting events, and brand events. These venues feature proprietary audio, visual, and 4D technologies, and are delivered through physical venue management and event production.

products.name: Original Immersive Content and Productions
products.description: Development and production of proprietary immersive shows and films, purpose-built for Sphere venues, using in-house creative and production teams and proprietary technology. Delivered as ticketed events within Sphere venues.

products.name: Venue Advertising and Sponsorship (Sphere)
products.description: Sale of advertising and sponsorship opportunities, including digital campaigns on the Exosphere (the venue's exterior LED display) and branded spaces within the venue. Delivered through physical and digital media placements to event attendees and the broader public.

products.name: Premium Hospitality and Event Services (Sphere)
products.description: Provision of premium hospitality products such as suites, club spaces, and event hosting services for corporate and private clients at Sphere venues. Delivered through physical venue infrastructure and in-person service.

products.name: Regional Sports and Entertainment Networks (MSG Networks)
products.description: Operation of regional cable and satellite television networks (MSG Network and MSG Sportsnet) that broadcast live professional sports games, original programming, and entertainment content. Delivered via traditional TV distribution to subscribers in the New York area and beyond.

products.name: Direct-to-Consumer Sports Streaming (MSG+)
products.description: Provision of direct-to-consumer and authenticated streaming services (MSG+) offering live and on-demand sports content, including single-game purchases and subscriptions, accessible on digital devices. Delivered digitally via web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.

products.name: Streaming Technology and Services for Third Parties (GAME Joint Venture)
products.description: Provision of streaming technology and operational services to other networks, teams, and sports properties through the Gotham Advanced Media and Entertainment (GAME) joint venture. Delivered as a B2B service to enable launch and operation of streaming platforms.

products.name: Licensing of Venue Technology, Brand, and IP (Sphere Franchise/Partnerships)
products.description: Licensing of proprietary Sphere venue designs, technology, and intellectual property, as well as provision of operational and creative services to partners developing Sphere venues in other markets (e.g., Abu Dhabi). Delivered through franchise, management, or advisory agreements.

products.name: High-Performance Capacitors
products.description: Custom-designed, high-reliability capacitors, including specialty film types, manufactured at scale for demanding applications in defense, industrial, medtech, and electrification/energy markets. Production involves advanced materials and precision manufacturing processes.

products.name: Radio Frequency (RF) Filters and Solutions
products.description: Custom-engineered RF filters and related solutions, primarily serving defense and industrial markets, produced using specialized engineering and manufacturing facilities to meet broad frequency and reliability requirements.

products.name: Balanced Armature Speakers
products.description: Precision-manufactured balanced armature speakers designed for hearing health and specialty audio applications, produced using advanced acoustic engineering and scalable manufacturing for OEM customers.

products.name: Advanced Microphones
products.description: High-reliability, custom-engineered microphones for hearing health and specialty audio markets, manufactured to meet stringent size, frequency response, and low power requirements for OEMs.

products.name: Gold Products
products.description: Extraction and sale of gold, primarily in the form of doré bars produced through milling, heap leaching, roasting, autoclaving, or flotation, which are then refined to bullion meeting market standards. Some gold is also sold in concentrate form containing other metals.

products.name: Copper Concentrate
products.description: Production and sale of copper concentrate, extracted from ore via crushing, grinding, and flotation processes at select mining operations, and sold to smelters for further treatment and refining.

products.name: Silver Concentrate
products.description: Production and sale of silver, primarily as a co-product or by-product in concentrate form, extracted through flotation and sold to smelters for further processing.

products.name: Lead Concentrate
products.description: Production and sale of lead concentrate, extracted from ore via flotation at certain mining operations, with lead concentrate enriched in gold and silver, sold to smelters for further processing.

products.name: Zinc Concentrate
products.description: Production and sale of zinc concentrate, produced through flotation processes at select mines, and sold to smelters for further treatment and refining.

products.name: Magnetic Resonance Instruments (NMR, EPR, MRI, MPI)
products.description: High-performance nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and magnetic particle imaging (MPI) instruments for molecular structure analysis, preclinical imaging, and research. These are physically manufactured systems requiring advanced engineering and are delivered as integrated hardware and software solutions.

products.name: Mass Spectrometry and Chromatography Systems
products.description: Mass spectrometry (MS) and chromatography instruments, including MALDI-TOF, ESI-TOF, MRMS, ITMS, GC-MS, LC-MS, and related sample preparation and informatics software, for life sciences, pharmaceutical, clinical, food, environmental, and forensics applications. These are complex, precision-manufactured devices with integrated digital workflows.

products.name: Microbiology and Molecular Diagnostics Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive solutions for microbial identification, antibiotic resistance and susceptibility testing, and PCR-based molecular diagnostics, including automated sample-to-answer PCR systems, test kits, and reagents. These are regulated, manufactured systems and consumables for clinical, food, and pharma microbiology.

products.name: Molecular Spectroscopy and Optical Analysis Instruments
products.description: Infrared (FT-IR, NIR, QCL IR), Raman spectroscopy, and related optical analysis instruments for research, quality control, process analysis, and detection of chemical, biological, and explosive substances. These are precision-manufactured devices used in laboratories and industrial settings.

products.name: Analytical X-ray and Electron Microscopy Instruments
products.description: Advanced X-ray (XRD, XRF, SC-XRD, µCT), electron microscopy (STEM), and associated analytical tools (EDS, EBSD, S-OES, CS/ONH) for materials characterization, elemental analysis, and 3D imaging. These are large, physically manufactured systems for academic, industrial, and semiconductor applications.

products.name: Atomic Force Microscopy and Surface Metrology Systems
products.description: Atomic force microscopy (AFM), stylus and optical metrology (SOM), tribology and mechanical test systems (TMT), and related non-contact dimensional metrology instruments for nanoscale and surface analysis. These are precision instruments for research and industrial quality control.

products.name: Spatial Biology and Genomics Platforms
products.description: Spatial molecular imaging, digital spatial profiling, single-cell analysis, and multi-omics platforms (e.g., CosMx, GeoMx, nCounter, Cellscape, PaintScape) for spatial transcriptomics, proteomics, and genomics research. These are advanced digital and hardware platforms for life science research and clinical trials.

products.name: Lab Automation and Digital Workflow Solutions
products.description: Vendor-agnostic lab automation platforms, workflow integration software, and data management suites for automating and digitizing laboratory and manufacturing processes. These are digital and hardware solutions supporting laboratory efficiency and compliance.

products.name: CBRNE Detection Systems
products.description: Portable and integrated detection systems for chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosive (CBRNE) threats, including handheld chemical detectors and comprehensive detection suites. These are specialized, regulated devices for defense, security, and process monitoring.

products.name: Superconducting Materials and Devices
products.description: Metallic low and high temperature superconductors (LTS, HTS), including wires, conductors, and solenoids, for use in MRI, NMR, fusion energy, and other high-field applications. These are physically manufactured materials and components for medical, scientific, and industrial use.

products.name: Synchrotron and Beamline Instrumentation
products.description: Non-superconducting high technology tools, such as synchrotron and beamline instrumentation, for materials research and high energy physics. These are custom-engineered systems for advanced research facilities.

products.name: Engineered Copper-Clad Aluminum Conductors (Cuponal)
products.description: Cuponal copper-clad aluminum conductors as a lightweight, cost-effective alternative to solid copper for electrical and aerospace applications. These are manufactured materials for industrial customers.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of commercial loans and leases, including commercial and industrial loans, owner-occupied commercial loans, commercial mortgages, construction loans, and small business leases. These are originated and serviced primarily through in-person banking professionals and digital channels, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loan products such as home equity lines of credit, installment loans, unsecured lines of credit, and education loans, delivered through branch offices, digital platforms, and partnerships. Requires financial capital, underwriting, and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Originates and services residential first mortgage loans, home equity loans, and reverse mortgages, primarily through WSFS Mortgage® and branch offices. Involves underwriting, regulatory compliance, and may include secondary market sales.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a variety of deposit products including savings accounts, demand deposits, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit to consumer, commercial, and institutional clients, delivered via branch network, ATMs, and digital platforms. Requires regulated infrastructure and capital management.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Provides fee-only asset management, financial planning, investment management, and advisory services to individuals, families, and institutions, primarily through Bryn Mawr Trust Advisors and related entities. Delivered by licensed professionals and digital platforms, requiring regulatory registration and compliance.

products.name: Personal and Institutional Trust and Fiduciary Services
products.description: Offers personal and institutional trust services, including directed trusts, asset protection trusts, dynasty trusts, estate administration, trust tax planning, and custody, delivered through trust companies and specialized teams. Requires legal, regulatory, and fiduciary expertise.

products.name: ATM Vault Cash, Smart Safe, and Cash Logistics Services
products.description: Provides ATM vault cash, smart safe solutions, and cash logistics services to non-bank and bank clients nationwide, including cash management, armored carrier management, and loss protection. Delivered via physical infrastructure, technology, and partnerships.

products.name: Commercial Domicile and Registered Agent Services
products.description: Provides commercial domicile services, including provision of employees, directors, subleases of office facilities, and registered agent services in Delaware and Nevada, primarily to institutional and corporate clients. Delivered through specialized subsidiaries and legal infrastructure.

products.name: Equipment Leasing and Commercial Financing
products.description: Originates small business leases and provides commercial financing for equipment in categories such as technology, software, office, medical, and veterinary, delivered nationwide through NewLane Finance®. Involves underwriting, asset management, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage and Related Services
products.description: Offers insurance brokerage services and related insurance products, including through NewLane Finance® subsidiary Prime Protect, delivered via licensed agents and digital channels. Requires regulatory compliance and partnerships with insurers.

products.name: Capital Markets and Treasury Management Services
products.description: Provides capital markets products such as interest rate derivatives, foreign exchange, trade finance, and treasury management services to commercial and institutional clients, delivered by specialized teams and technology platforms. Requires financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Rolling Papers and Tubes
products.description: Manufactured and distributed under the Zig-Zag® brand, these are premium rolling papers, tubes, and related products sourced from third-party suppliers and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels in North America. Production is outsourced, focusing on packaging, marketing, and distribution.

products.name: Cigar Wraps and Cigarillos
products.description: Includes make-your-own (MYO) cigar wraps (HTL, hemp, and natural leaf) and finished cigars/cigarillos, primarily under the Zig-Zag® brand. Products are sourced from suppliers in the Dominican Republic and distributed through retail and alternative channels.

products.name: Alternative Smoking Accessories
products.description: A range of smoking accessories, including cannabis accessories, marketed and distributed under the Zig-Zag® brand and through Turning Point Brands Canada. Products are sourced and distributed to retail, headshops, dispensaries, and e-commerce.

products.name: Moist Snuff Tobacco (MST)
products.description: Manufactured in-house using proprietary processes at company facilities, Stoker’s® moist snuff tobacco is produced from American leaf and packaged in tubs and cans for distribution to retail outlets.

products.name: Loose-Leaf Chewing Tobacco
products.description: Loose-leaf chewing tobacco products, primarily under the Stoker’s®, Beech-Nut®, Trophy®, and other brands, are contract manufactured by Swedish Match using company-sourced tobacco and proprietary flavorings, then marketed and distributed by the company.

products.name: Modern Oral Nicotine Products
products.description: Tobacco-free white pouch nicotine products, including FRE® and ALP®, are contract manufactured and distributed under company brands. These products are sold in various nicotine strengths and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Pet Food and Nutrition Products
products.description: A broad assortment of national, owned, and exclusive brand pet foods and nutritional products, sold through physical stores and digital channels, requiring sourcing, inventory management, and compliance with food safety regulations.

products.name: Pet Supplies and Accessories
products.description: A wide variety of pet care supplies and accessories, including toys, bedding, grooming tools, and other non-food products, sourced from multiple vendors and sold in-store and online.

products.name: Companion Animals
products.description: Live companion animals such as fish, reptiles, birds, and small mammals, sold through physical pet care centers, requiring regulated handling and care.

products.name: Veterinary Care Services
products.description: Full-service veterinary hospitals and Vetco clinics providing medical care, preventive services, and prescription medications, delivered in-store and through dedicated clinics, requiring licensed veterinarians and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Pet Grooming Services
products.description: In-store grooming services for pets, including bathing, haircuts, and nail trimming, delivered by trained staff at pet care centers.

products.name: Pet Training Services
products.description: In-person pet training classes and behavioral support, delivered by trained staff at pet care centers.

products.name: Digital Pet Care Platform
products.description: E-commerce and mobile app platforms (Petco.com and Petco app) enabling online shopping, appointment booking, and digital-to-store experiences, requiring digital infrastructure and technology investment.

products.name: Pet Membership and Subscription Services
products.description: Membership programs and subscription offerings such as repeat delivery and loyalty benefits, managed digitally and integrated with in-store and online purchases.

products.name: Frac Sand Supply
products.description: Production and sale of Northern White frac sand, a premium proppant used to enhance hydrocarbon recovery rates in hydraulic fracturing of oil and natural gas wells. The sand is mined, processed, and delivered via a network of rail-connected facilities and in-basin transloading terminals.

products.name: Industrial Sand Products
products.description: Production and sale of processed sand for industrial applications such as glass, foundry, building products, filtration, geothermal, renewables, ceramics, turf & landscape, retail, and recreation. Sand is processed and blended at company facilities and delivered to industrial customers.

products.name: Proppant Logistics Solutions
products.description: Provision of logistics services for proppant delivery, including in-basin transloading terminals, rail transportation, and management of sand supply chain from mine to wellsite. Services include operating and managing transloading terminals and coordinating rail shipments to oil and gas basins.

products.name: Wellsite Proppant Handling Equipment and Services (SmartSystems)
products.description: Rental and provision of portable wellsite proppant storage and management systems, including SmartDepot silos, SmartBelt conveyors, SmartPath management systems, and rapid deployment trailers. These systems are delivered, set up, and maintained at customer wellsites to enhance efficiency and safety in proppant handling.

products.name: Trading Platform (Everything Exchange)
products.description: A digital platform enabling retail and institutional customers to trade a wide range of assets including crypto, stocks, commodity futures, perpetual futures, and prediction markets. Delivered via web and mobile interfaces, with both simple and advanced trading experiences, and supported by proprietary exchange infrastructure.

products.name: Institutional Prime Brokerage and Trading Services
products.description: A suite of services for institutional clients, including access to deep liquidity, prime brokerage, and trading across spot and derivatives markets, delivered through Coinbase Prime and multiple proprietary and partner exchanges.

products.name: Stablecoin Products (USDC, EURC, etc.)
products.description: A set of stablecoin offerings, primarily USDC and EURC, provided in partnership with Circle and others, enabling customers to hold, transact, and earn rewards on stablecoins pegged to fiat currencies. Revenue is generated through economic sharing agreements and on-platform usage.

products.name: Onchain Staking Services
products.description: A service allowing customers to stake supported crypto assets through Coinbase, earning protocol rewards while Coinbase earns a commission. Includes both consumer and institutional staking, as well as wrapped staking tokens like cbETH.

products.name: Self-Custodial Wallet (Base App)
products.description: A mobile application providing users with a self-custodial wallet to store, trade, and interact with decentralized applications, integrating trading, payments, and social features. Users retain sole control of their cryptographic keys.

products.name: Blockchain Infrastructure (Base L2)
products.description: A decentralized Layer 2 Ethereum blockchain operated by Coinbase, supporting fast, low-cost onchain transactions and an ecosystem of decentralized applications. Revenue is generated from sequencer fees on processed transactions.

products.name: Institutional Financing and Lending
products.description: A range of financing products for institutional clients, including real-time trading credit, leverage, short selling, and structured loans, as well as managed lending and borrowing of fiat, crypto, and stablecoins.

products.name: Institutional Custody Services
products.description: A secure custody platform for institutional clients, offering cold and hot wallet solutions for digital assets, including services for ETF issuers and global clients. Fees are charged based on assets under custody.

products.name: Consumer Subscription Services (Coinbase One)
products.description: A subscription service for retail customers providing benefits such as reduced trading fees, higher staking rewards, USDC rewards, priority support, and credit card rewards. Delivered via tiered membership and generates recurring revenue.

products.name: Developer Platform (Coinbase Developer Platform)
products.description: A set of APIs, SDKs, and tools enabling businesses and developers to build and scale crypto-enabled products, integrating payments, trading, wallets, and stablecoins into their own offerings.

products.name: Credit and Debit Card Services (Coinbase Card, Coinbase One Credit Card)
products.description: Branded credit and debit cards allowing consumers to spend crypto and earn rewards, including up to 4% Bitcoin back. Cards are issued in partnership with banks and payment networks, generating interchange and related fees.

products.name: Industrial Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of industrial real estate properties across the United States, primarily in secondary and tertiary markets. Properties are physically owned, managed, and leased to tenants under long-term agreements, with tenants typically responsible for operating expenses and maintenance.

products.name: Retail Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of retail real estate properties, including shopping centers and standalone retail buildings. These are physically owned and managed properties leased to retail tenants under various lease structures.

products.name: Other Commercial Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of other commercial real estate properties, including office buildings, theaters, health and fitness centers, and restaurants. These are physically owned and leased to tenants under long-term agreements.

products.name: Envu (allosteric TYK2 inhibitor)
products.description: A small molecule, orally administered, allosteric TYK2 inhibitor developed for the treatment of immune-mediated diseases, initially targeting moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis (PsO) and systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), with potential expansion to additional indications. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral drug product.

products.name: A-005 (CNS-penetrant allosteric TYK2 inhibitor)
products.description: A small molecule, orally administered, CNS-penetrant allosteric TYK2 inhibitor designed to treat neuroinflammatory and neurodegenerative diseases such as multiple sclerosis (MS), Alzheimer’s disease, ALS, optic neuritis, neuromyelitis optica, and Parkinson’s disease. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as an oral drug product.

products.name: Lonigutamab (IGF-1R monoclonal antibody)
products.description: A subcutaneously delivered monoclonal antibody targeting IGF-1R, acquired via the ACELYRIN merger, for the potential treatment of Thyroid Eye Disease (TED). Manufactured using biologic processes and administered via subcutaneous injection.

products.name: Preclinical Immunology Therapeutics (including IRF5 inhibitors)
products.description: A pipeline of small molecule therapeutics in preclinical development targeting immune dysfunction, including inhibitors of IRF5 and other genetically validated targets, for a broad range of immune-mediated diseases. These are developed using structure-guided and computational drug discovery approaches.

products.name: Unified Communications as a Service (UCaaS)
products.description: A cloud-based communications platform (RingEX) that integrates voice, messaging (SMS, MMS, team chat), video meetings, fax, analytics, and APIs, delivered via subscription and accessible globally. Requires robust cloud infrastructure and telephony integrations.

products.name: Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS)
products.description: Cloud-based contact center solutions (RingCentral Contact Center and RingCX) providing omni-channel customer engagement, workforce engagement, analytics, and CRM integrations, delivered via subscription. Built on partnerships and proprietary technology, leveraging AI for automation and analytics.

products.name: AI-Powered Communication Solutions
products.description: A suite of AI-driven products (AI Receptionist, AI Virtual Assistant, AI Conversation Expert, AVA Agent Assist, AVA Supervisor Assist, AI Quality Management) that automate, augment, and analyze business communications across UCaaS and CCaaS platforms. Delivered digitally as add-ons or integrated features.

products.name: Virtual and Hybrid Events Platform
products.description: A digital platform (RingCentral Events) for hosting virtual and hybrid multi-session conferences, with AI-powered attendee engagement, registration, and networking tools. Delivered as a cloud-based service with integrations to CRM and marketing automation.

products.name: Microsoft Teams Integration Solutions
products.description: Embedded communication solutions that integrate RingCentral’s phone, SMS, fax, and customer experience capabilities directly into Microsoft Teams, enabling enterprise-grade telephony and messaging without requiring a Teams Phone license.

products.name: Customer Engagement Bundle
products.description: A bundled solution combining phone, messaging, SMS, advanced call queues, and analytics for businesses, designed to streamline communications and provide supervisors with actionable insights. Delivered as a subscription-based cloud service.

products.name: Pre-configured Phones (Third-Party Hardware)
products.description: Sale of pre-configured physical phones sourced from third-party manufacturers, offered as a convenience to customers to complement cloud-based communication services. Fulfillment is handled by partners; RingCentral does not manufacture these devices.

products.name: Professional Services (Implementation and Support)
products.description: Onboarding, implementation, configuration, and post-sale support services to help customers set up and use RingCentral’s communication systems. Delivered by in-person or remote human labor, often as an ancillary service to subscriptions.

products.name: DecisionDx-Melanoma
products.description: A proprietary gene expression profile (GEP) test for risk stratification in invasive cutaneous melanoma, performed on tissue samples in CLIA-certified labs and delivered as a clinical report to aid treatment decisions.

products.name: TissueCypher
products.description: A proprietary spatialomics-based risk stratification test for Barrett’s esophagus, performed on endoscopic or non-endoscopic esophageal tissue samples in CLIA-certified labs, providing clinicians with molecular risk assessment for progression to high-grade dysplasia or esophageal cancer.

products.name: AdvanceAD-Tx
products.description: A non-invasive gene expression profile (GEP) test for guiding systemic treatment selection in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, using analysis of 487 genes from patient samples to classify disease biology and inform therapy choice.

products.name: DecisionDx-SCC
products.description: A proprietary GEP test for high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, performed on tissue samples to predict metastatic risk and responsiveness to adjuvant radiation therapy, delivered as a clinical report to inform management decisions.

products.name: MyPath Melanoma
products.description: A proprietary diagnostic GEP test for difficult-to-diagnose melanocytic lesions, performed on tissue samples to assist in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions, with results provided to clinicians for patient management.

products.name: DecisionDx-UM
products.description: A proprietary GEP test for uveal melanoma (ocular melanoma), performed on tissue samples to predict metastatic risk, with results delivered to clinicians to guide surveillance and treatment.

products.name: Esopredict
products.description: A methylation-based risk stratification test for Barrett’s esophagus, performed on esophageal cell samples (potentially collected via non-endoscopic, swallowable device), offered as a supplemental option when TissueCypher is inconclusive.

products.name: Video Displays and Video Walls
products.description: Large-format indoor and outdoor LED video displays and video walls, manufactured using advanced LED technology, capable of displaying video, graphics, and animation for venues such as stadiums, arenas, retail, transportation hubs, and commercial spaces. Delivered as both standard and custom-integrated systems, often including proprietary control software and hardware.

products.name: Scoreboards and Timing Systems
products.description: Indoor and outdoor electronic scoreboards and timing systems for various sports, including controllers and statistics software, manufactured and installed for sports venues ranging from schools to professional arenas. Delivered as standalone products or as part of integrated systems.

products.name: LED Message Displays and Signs
products.description: Full-matrix indoor and outdoor LED message displays and signs, primarily for on-premise advertising and information, manufactured and controlled via proprietary software. Delivered as standard catalog products or custom solutions for commercial and institutional customers.

products.name: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Dynamic Message Signs
products.description: LED dynamic message signs for road management and transportation applications, including freeway, arterial, and toll booth displays, manufactured and installed with specialized control systems for transportation agencies.

products.name: Mass Transit Displays
products.description: LCD and LED display solutions for public transportation, such as railway platforms and bus stations, manufactured and installed as networked systems to guide travelers and provide real-time information.

products.name: Sound Systems
products.description: Standard and custom sound systems for indoor and outdoor sports venues, manufactured and often integrated with display and scoring systems as part of a complete venue solution.

products.name: Digital Billboards and Street Furniture
products.description: Digital billboards and LED street furniture for out-of-home advertising, manufactured for outdoor environments with features such as high brightness, energy efficiency, and networked content management. Delivered to advertising companies and municipalities.

products.name: Digit and Price Displays
products.description: Outdoor digit and price displays, including time, temperature, and fuel price signs, manufactured for industries such as petroleum and retail, featuring remote sensors and quick-update capabilities.

products.name: Indoor Dynamic Messaging Systems
products.description: Indoor dynamic messaging solutions for retailers and convenience stores, delivered via LED or LCD displays and managed through proprietary software platforms, enabling targeted advertising and information campaigns.

products.name: Display Control Software and Controllers
products.description: Proprietary software platforms and hardware controllers for scheduling, managing, and operating display content, including live video, real-time data, and advertising, delivered as on-premise or cloud-based solutions for single or networked displays.

products.name: Professional Services and Support
products.description: Professional services including event support, content creation, training, installation, maintenance, and technical support for display and control systems, delivered by in-house staff and third-party partners to ensure optimal system performance and customer satisfaction.

products.name: Zidesamtinib (NVL-520)
products.description: A precisely targeted, orally administered small molecule ROS1-selective kinase inhibitor developed for the treatment of ROS1-positive non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) and other solid tumors. Manufactured via synthetic chemistry and delivered as an oral tablet, it is designed to overcome resistance mutations, improve brain penetrance, and minimize off-target adverse events. Commercialization is planned upon regulatory approval.

products.name: Neladalkib (NVL-655)
products.description: A brain-penetrant, orally administered small molecule ALK-selective kinase inhibitor developed for the treatment of ALK-positive NSCLC and other solid tumors. Manufactured using synthetic processes, it is designed to address resistance to first-, second-, and third-generation ALK inhibitors, improve brain penetrance, and reduce off-target effects. Commercialization is planned upon regulatory approval.

products.name: NVL-330 (HER2-Selective Inhibitor)
products.description: A brain-penetrant, orally administered small molecule HER2-selective kinase inhibitor in clinical development for the treatment of HER2-altered NSCLC and other cancers with HER2 mutations. Manufactured via synthetic chemistry, it is designed to address tumors with HER2 mutations, including those with brain metastases, while minimizing off-target effects. Currently in early-stage clinical trials.

products.name: Discovery-stage Small Molecule Kinase Inhibitors for Oncology
products.description: A pipeline of early-stage research and development programs focused on discovering and developing novel, highly selective small molecule kinase inhibitors for various oncology indications. These are manufactured via synthetic chemistry and are in preclinical or discovery phases, with the intent to address unmet needs in cancer treatment.

products.name: Chassis and Suspension Solutions
products.description: Manufactured steel chassis, axles, anti-lock braking systems, and suspension systems for RVs, transportation, marine, and housing industries, produced in over 100 manufacturing facilities using metal fabrication and welding.

products.name: Furniture Solutions
products.description: Manufactured furniture and mattresses for RV, marine, and other markets, produced in dedicated furniture manufacturing facilities and distributed to OEM and aftermarket customers.

products.name: Window and Glass Solutions
products.description: Vinyl, aluminum, and frameless windows and windshields for RVs, buses, marine, and housing, produced using glass fabrication and distributed to OEMs and aftermarket channels.

products.name: Appliance and Kitchen Solutions
products.description: Manufactured air conditioners, tankless water heaters, appliances, electronic components, televisions, and thermoformed bath and kitchen products for RVs, marine, and housing, produced in specialized facilities and distributed to OEMs and aftermarket.

products.name: Towing and Truck Accessories
products.description: Manufactured hitches, pin boxes, grill guards, towing electrical, and truck accessories for RV, automotive, marine, and trailer industries, produced in manufacturing facilities and distributed through OEM and aftermarket channels.

products.name: Doors, Steps, and Awnings
products.description: Manufactured entry, luggage, patio, and ramp doors, electric and manual entry steps, and awnings for RVs, marine, transportation, and housing, produced in manufacturing facilities and distributed to OEMs and aftermarket.

products.name: Leveling, Stabilization, and Slide-out Systems
products.description: Manufactured stabilizer/leveling systems (manual, electric, and hydraulic) and slide-out solutions for RVs and adjacent industries, produced in manufacturing facilities and distributed to OEMs and aftermarket.

products.name: Aftermarket Replacement Parts and Accessories
products.description: Discretionary accessories, replacement parts, and upgrades for RV, transportation, marine, and automotive markets, sold through retail dealers, wholesale distributors, service centers, and direct-to-consumer online platforms.

products.name: Service and Repair Centers
products.description: Installation, service, repairs, and upfits for RV, transportation, marine, and automotive products, provided through a network of Lippert Factory Service centers staffed by expert technicians.

products.name: Regulated Water Utility Services
products.description: Provision of treated, stored, and distributed water for residential, commercial, industrial, and fire protection purposes through owned and operated regulated water utility systems in New Jersey and Delaware. Requires physical infrastructure, water treatment plants, wells, and is subject to public utility regulation.

products.name: Regulated Wastewater Utility Services
products.description: Collection, treatment, and disposal of wastewater for residential and municipal customers through regulated wastewater utility systems, involving physical treatment plants and compliance with environmental regulations.

products.name: Contract Water and Wastewater Operations and Maintenance Services
products.description: Operation and maintenance of water, wastewater, and stormwater systems under contract for municipal and private clients, including day-to-day operations, emergency response, and capital project management. Delivered via in-person labor and technical expertise, not regulated as public utilities.

products.name: Wholesale Water Supply
products.description: Sale of bulk treated water to municipal and utility customers under wholesale contracts, supplementing their own water systems. Requires large-scale water treatment and distribution infrastructure.

products.name: Residential Water and Wastewater Home Maintenance Programs
products.description: Provision of water and wastewater-related home maintenance service programs to residential customers through a marketing agreement, including billing and administrative services. Delivered in partnership with a third-party provider.

products.name: Shopping Center Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of multi-tenant shopping centers, primarily through fee simple ownership, with tenants under long-term leases. Properties are physically managed and require ongoing property management services, with tenants typically paying a share of operating expenses.

products.name: Other Commercial Property Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of other income-producing commercial properties, including single-tenant retail, office, and mixed-use assets, typically under double or triple net leases. Delivery requires property acquisition, leasing, and management.

products.name: Management Services
products.description: Fee-based management of real estate assets for third parties, including related parties (such as PINE) and external clients, covering asset management, portfolio management, and subsurface asset management. Services are delivered through in-person professional labor and administration.

products.name: Commercial Loans and Investments
products.description: Origination and investment in commercial real estate loans and preferred equity, secured by various property types. Delivery involves financial capital and underwriting, with income generated from interest and origination fees.

products.name: Mitigation Credits Sales (Discontinued)
products.description: Sale of environmental mitigation credits produced by a formerly owned mitigation bank. Delivery required regulatory compliance and management of land for environmental purposes. As of 2025, this business line has been exited.

products.name: Subsurface Interests Leasing and Sales (Discontinued)
products.description: Leasing and sale of subsurface mineral rights, including leasing exploration rights and collecting royalties from mineral production. Delivery involved legal agreements and management of mineral assets. As of 2025, this business line has been exited.

products.name: Peripheral Vascular Devices
products.description: A suite of medical devices developed, manufactured, and marketed for use in open and endovascular procedures to treat peripheral vascular disease. These devices are primarily used by vascular surgeons and include catheters, shunts, closure systems, and other tools. Products are physically manufactured and distributed globally, requiring regulatory approvals.

products.name: Biologic and Synthetic Vascular Grafts
products.description: Manufactured biologic (bovine, ovine, human) and synthetic (polyester, ePTFE) vascular grafts used to bypass or replace diseased arteries and for dialysis access. These products are physically produced in specialized facilities and require regulatory compliance for medical use.

products.name: Cardiac and Vascular Patches
products.description: Biologic and synthetic patches (primarily bovine pericardium) used for vessel and heart repair, closure after surgical intervention, and reconstruction. These patches are manufactured and distributed for use in vascular and cardiac surgeries.

products.name: Human Tissue Cryopreservation Services (Allografts)
products.description: Processing and cryopreservation of human vascular and cardiac tissue (allografts), including veins, arteries, and valved conduits, for transplantation in vascular and cardiac surgeries. Services are performed in specialized, regulated facilities and involve tissue procurement, processing, storage, and distribution.

products.name: Balloon Catheters (Embolectomy, Thrombectomy, Occlusion, Perfusion)
products.description: A range of balloon catheters designed for embolectomy (clot removal), thrombectomy, occlusion (temporarily blocking blood flow), and perfusion (infusing fluids). These are manufactured medical devices used in vascular procedures.

products.name: Carotid Shunts
products.description: Medical devices used to temporarily shunt blood during carotid endarterectomy surgery, including balloon and non-balloon fixation types. These are manufactured and supplied to vascular surgeons for use in open surgical procedures.

products.name: Vessel Closure Systems
products.description: Titanium clip-based closure systems used to attach vessels or close dura in neuro applications, providing an alternative to sutures in vascular and neuro surgeries. These are manufactured devices delivered to surgical settings.

products.name: Valvulotomes (Valve Cutters)
products.description: Surgical instruments designed to cut or disrupt venous valves, enabling the use of veins as arterial conduits in bypass surgeries. These are precision-manufactured devices used in open vascular procedures.

products.name: Phlebectomy System
products.description: Powered phlebectomy systems for resection and ablation of varicose veins, including visualization and infusion tools. These are manufactured medical devices used in minimally invasive vein procedures.

products.name: Radiopaque Tape
products.description: Medical-grade tape with radiopaque markings for use in surgical procedures to provide visual and x-ray reference points on the patient's body. Manufactured and distributed as a surgical accessory.

products.name: Electronic and Electromechanical Assemblies
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacturing of high-reliability electronic and electromechanical products such as complex cable assemblies, interconnect systems, printed circuit board assemblies, avionics racks, shipboard enclosures, and lightning diversion systems. Production involves integrated manufacturing, fabrication, machining, assembly, and electronic integration for aerospace, defense, industrial, and medical markets.

products.name: Engineered Electronic Components
products.description: Production of specialized engineered electronic components including illuminated pushbutton switches and panels, microwave and millimeter switches and filters, motors, and resolvers for motion control, primarily for aviation, test systems, and radio frequency applications. These are manufactured using advanced engineering and fabrication processes.

products.name: Aerostructure Components and Assemblies
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacturing of large, complex contoured aerostructure components and assemblies, including aluminum, titanium, and Inconel parts, winglets, engine components, fuselage panels, and bonded metal and composite structures for commercial and military aircraft. Production uses advanced machining, metal bonding, composite layup, and chemical milling.

products.name: Ammunition Handling Systems
products.description: Design and manufacture of ammunition handling systems such as feed and eject chutes, storage magazines, and custom gun mounts for military aircraft and ground vehicles. These systems are engineered and produced using specialized fabrication and assembly processes for defense applications.

products.name: Seals and O-Rings
products.description: Manufacture of magnetic, mechanical, and lip seals, as well as O-rings, for military and industrial applications. These products are produced using precision engineering and materials processing for high-reliability environments.

products.name: Aerodynamic Systems
products.description: Design and production of aerodynamic systems and engineered structural components that enhance the productivity, performance, and safety of rotary and fixed-wing aircraft on commercial and military platforms. These systems are manufactured using advanced engineering and fabrication techniques.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering and Processing Services
products.description: Williams gathers, treats, and processes natural gas from producers' wells, removing contaminants and extracting natural gas liquids (NGLs) through a network of pipelines and processing plants. These services are delivered via physical infrastructure and long-term contracts.

products.name: Interstate Natural Gas Transportation and Storage Services
products.description: Williams transports and stores natural gas for utilities, industrial users, and other customers through a regulated network of interstate pipelines and underground storage facilities, operating under long-term contracts and FERC regulation.

products.name: Market-Based Rate Natural Gas Storage Services
products.description: Williams provides natural gas storage services at market-based rates through dedicated storage assets, offering capacity to utilities, power generators, and marketers, separate from its regulated pipeline storage.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Fractionation, Transportation, and Storage Services
products.description: Williams fractionates, transports, and stores NGLs (such as ethane, propane, butane) extracted from natural gas, using specialized facilities and pipelines, and provides these services to petrochemical and refining industry customers.

products.name: Crude Oil Transportation and Production Handling Services
products.description: Williams operates deepwater crude oil pipelines and offshore production platforms, providing transportation and centralized production handling (compression, separation, water removal) for oil producers, primarily in the Gulf of America.

products.name: Natural Gas and NGL Marketing Services
products.description: Williams markets natural gas and NGLs, providing asset management, wholesale marketing, trading, storage, and transportation services to utilities, power generators, and producers, leveraging both owned and third-party assets.

products.name: Power Generation Infrastructure Services
products.description: Williams develops and operates onsite natural gas and power generation infrastructure to support data centers and industrial customers in power-constrained markets, delivered through construction projects and long-term agreements.

products.name: Aerial Work Platforms and Telehandlers
products.description: Designs and manufactures aerial work platforms and telehandlers for construction, industrial, agricultural, vegetation management, and maintenance applications, delivered through physical manufacturing and global distribution networks.

products.name: Towing and Recovery Equipment
products.description: Designs and manufactures towing and recovery vehicles such as carriers, wreckers, and rotators, delivered through physical manufacturing and supported by installation and service parts sales.

products.name: Fire Apparatus and Emergency Vehicles
products.description: Designs and manufactures commercial and custom fire apparatus and emergency vehicles, including pumpers, aerial platforms, ladder trucks, rescue vehicles, and wildland response vehicles, built to customer specifications and delivered through a dealer network.

products.name: Aviation Ground Support Equipment and Airport Facility Services
products.description: Designs and manufactures airport ground support equipment (GSE), gate equipment, and provides airport facility operations, baggage handling, and equipment-monitoring technology services, delivered through manufacturing and service contracts.

products.name: Aircraft Rescue and Firefighting (ARFF) Vehicles
products.description: Designs and manufactures specialized ARFF vehicles for domestic and international airports, including both internal combustion and electrified models, delivered through direct sales and dealer networks.

products.name: Refuse and Recycling Collection Vehicles
products.description: Designs and manufactures refuse and recycling collection vehicles and components, including electric vehicle solutions, delivered through manufacturing and supported by parts and aftermarket services.

products.name: Field Service Vehicles and Truck-Mounted Cranes
products.description: Designs and manufactures field service vehicles and truck-mounted cranes for construction, equipment dealers, rental, utility, and other industries, delivered through manufacturing and global distribution.

products.name: Command Vehicles and Simulator Shelters
products.description: Manufactures and integrates command trucks and military simulator shelters and trailers for disaster relief, law enforcement, emergency management, and military customers, delivered through custom manufacturing and integration.

products.name: Front-Discharge Concrete Mixers
products.description: Designs and manufactures front-discharge concrete mixer vehicles for the ready-mix concrete industry, delivered through manufacturing and direct sales.

products.name: Military Tactical Wheeled Vehicles and Mobility Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sustains heavy, medium, and light tactical wheeled vehicles and mobility systems for military applications, including combat, logistics, and autonomous vehicles, delivered through government contracts and direct sales.

products.name: Postal and Commercial Delivery Vehicles
products.description: Designs and manufactures purpose-built delivery vehicles, including the Next Generation Delivery Vehicle (NGDV) for the USPS, with both internal combustion and electric powertrains, delivered through large-scale manufacturing contracts.

products.name: Senior Health Insurance Distribution
products.description: Direct-to-consumer distribution of Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, prescription drug, dental, vision, hearing, and critical illness insurance policies from multiple carriers, delivered via licensed agents and a proprietary technology platform. Involves agent consultation, comparison shopping, and digital engagement.

products.name: Life Insurance Distribution
products.description: Direct-to-consumer distribution of life insurance products, including term life, final expense, critical illness, accidental death, and juvenile insurance, through a technology-enabled platform and licensed agents. Customers compare and purchase policies from multiple national carriers.

products.name: Auto & Home Insurance Distribution
products.description: Direct-to-consumer distribution of property and casualty insurance products, including homeowners, auto, dwelling fire, and ancillary insurance, via a digital platform and licensed agents. Customers can compare and purchase policies from multiple leading carriers.

products.name: Pharmacy Services (SelectRx)
products.description: Provision of prescription medications, over-the-counter medications, customized medication packaging, and medication therapy management through a Patient-Centered Pharmacy Home model. Services are delivered via a closed-door pharmacy with fulfillment facilities and technology-enabled patient engagement.

products.name: Chronic Care Management Services (SelectPatient Management)
products.description: Technology-enhanced chronic care management services for patients with chronic conditions, offered to providers, payers, and Accountable Care Organizations. Services include patient engagement, care navigation, and support for non-clinical factors impacting health.

products.name: Healthcare Navigation and Engagement Services (Healthcare Select)
products.description: Personalized healthcare navigation and engagement services for seniors, including health risk and lifestyle assessments, education, and connection to health-related products and services. Delivered through digital tools and customer success agents leveraging real-time data.

products.name: Transplant Rejection Molecular Diagnostic Test Kits (GraftAssure family)
products.description: Molecular diagnostic test kits for monitoring transplanted organ rejection, including LDTs performed at a CLIA-certified lab, RUO kits for research, and IVD kits for clinical use. These are manufactured using proprietary biomarker assays and delivered as kits for in-house use by hospitals, labs, and research centers.

products.name: Laboratory Testing Services for Transplant Rejection (GraftAssureCore)
products.description: Clinical laboratory testing services for organ transplant rejection monitoring, performed at the company's CLIA-certified laboratory using proprietary molecular assays. Samples are processed and analyzed in-house, with results provided to healthcare providers.

products.name: Oncology Molecular Diagnostic Assays (DetermaIO and DetermaCNI)
products.description: Molecular diagnostic assays for oncology therapy selection and monitoring, developed for both clinical and research use. These tests utilize proprietary biomarkers and algorithms, and are intended for blood-based cancer diagnostics, though not currently commercialized.

products.name: Laboratory Services for Life Sciences and Biotechnology Companies
products.description: Custom assay development and clinical testing services provided to external life sciences and biotechnology companies, leveraging the company's laboratory infrastructure and scientific expertise. Services include development, validation, and execution of molecular assays for research or clinical purposes.

products.name: Scheduled Passenger Air Transportation
products.description: Operation of a major network air carrier providing scheduled air transportation for passengers to over 350 destinations worldwide, using a fleet of mainline and regional aircraft. Service is delivered via physical aircraft, regulated infrastructure, and in-person human labor.

products.name: Regional Passenger Air Transportation
products.description: Scheduled air transportation for passengers to smaller markets and as feeder service to mainline hubs, operated under the American Eagle brand by wholly-owned and third-party regional carriers. Delivered via smaller aircraft and coordinated with mainline operations.

products.name: Cargo Transportation Services
products.description: Freight and mail transportation services, including time-sensitive cargo, provided globally through dedicated cargo facilities and interline connections. Delivered via aircraft and supported by digital booking and tracking systems.

products.name: AAdvantage Loyalty Program
products.description: A loyalty program offering mileage credits, status rewards, and redemption options for flights, upgrades, and non-flight awards. Delivered digitally and through partnerships with airlines, credit card issuers, and other partners.

products.name: Co-branded Credit Card Programs
products.description: Co-branded credit cards issued in partnership with financial institutions, allowing customers to earn loyalty rewards and access exclusive benefits. Delivered through financial partners and integrated with the AAdvantage program.

products.name: Airport Lounge Services
products.description: Access to premium airport lounges (Admirals Club, Flagship Lounge, Provisions by Admirals Club) offering amenities and services to eligible passengers and loyalty program members. Delivered via physical lounge facilities at airports.

products.name: Hydraulic Fracturing (Well Stimulation) Services
products.description: Provision of hydraulic fracturing services using modern, technologically advanced pressure pumping fleets (diesel, dual-fuel, and electric) to upstream oil and gas companies, delivered on-site with specialized equipment and crews.

products.name: Frac Sand (Proppant) Production and Supply
products.description: Mining, processing, and delivery of in-basin frac sand (proppant) from multiple strategically located mines to oil and gas operators, enabling reliable, low-cost supply for hydraulic fracturing operations.

products.name: Specialty Oilfield Chemicals and Chemistry Solutions
products.description: Design, manufacture, packaging, and distribution of specialty green chemicals for oil and gas well completions and production, focused on improving environmental performance and operational efficiency for hydrocarbon producers.

products.name: Oilfield Data Analytics Solutions
products.description: Provision of real-time data analytics services and software to optimize hydrocarbon production processes, enabling customers to maximize value, reduce waste, and pursue automation in oil and gas operations.

products.name: Onsite Power Generation Services
products.description: Rental and operation of onsite power generation equipment (natural gas reciprocating engines and turbines) for oilfield and non-oilfield customers requiring off-grid power solutions, delivered as a service with owned and leased assets.

products.name: Oilfield Equipment Manufacturing and Sales
products.description: Design, assembly, and sale of hydraulic fracturing equipment and components (pumps, fluid ends, power ends, flow iron, consumables) to external customers in the oil and gas industry, leveraging in-house manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Ibezapolstat (DNA pol IIIC Inhibitor Antibiotic)
products.description: A novel, orally administered small molecule antibiotic targeting the DNA pol IIIC enzyme in Gram-positive bacteria, primarily developed for the treatment of Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI). It is manufactured through chemical synthesis and delivered as oral capsules, with clinical trials demonstrating high efficacy and a favorable safety profile.

products.name: Pol IIIC Inhibitor Antibiotic Pipeline (including ACX-375C and analogs)
products.description: A pipeline of small molecule antibiotics, including ACX-375C and related analogs, designed to inhibit DNA pol IIIC in Gram-positive bacteria such as MRSA, VRE, PRSP, and B. anthracis. These candidates are being developed for both oral and intravenous administration for systemic treatment of serious infections, with manufacturing involving chemical synthesis and formulation for oral or IV delivery.

products.name: Pressure-Treated Lumber and Outdoor Living Products
products.description: Manufactures and sells pressure-treated lumber products, including decking, fencing, lattice, and decorative and functional lawn and garden products, primarily for outdoor use. Products are produced at company facilities and distributed nationally to retailers and distributors.

products.name: Composite Decking and Accessories
products.description: Produces wood plastic composite and mineral-based composite decking, along with related accessories such as aluminum railing systems, balusters, post caps, and customized aluminum fencing. Products are manufactured and distributed to home improvement retailers and distributors.

products.name: Siding, Trim, and Pattern Boards
products.description: Manufactures and sells exterior siding, pattern, trim, and fascia products made from traditional, engineered, and modified wood, as well as interior pattern and trim products. Products are offered in various finishes and profiles and are distributed to retailers and distributors.

products.name: Custom Structural Packaging Solutions
products.description: Designs, engineers, manufactures, and tests custom packaging products primarily made of wood and metal, often including mixed materials, tailored to specific customer requirements. Products are produced using industrial engineering and testing at company facilities.

products.name: Wood Pallets and Pallet Recycling
products.description: Designs and manufactures new wood and heat-treated wood pallets in various sizes and configurations, and operates a recycling business for previously used pallets. Production is highly automated and vertically integrated for cost efficiency.

products.name: Protective Packaging Materials
products.description: Produces and supplies a variety of protective packaging materials such as corrugate, foam, labels, strapping, and films, including manufacturing of labels and corrugate boxes. These products are sold as part of comprehensive packaging solutions to industrial customers.

products.name: Factory-Built Housing Components and Distribution
products.description: Designs and manufactures roof trusses, cut-to-size lumber, plywood, and oriented strand board for use in manufactured housing, as well as distributing specialty products such as siding, electrical, and plumbing to factory-built housing and RV customers. Products are produced at regional facilities and distributed nationally.

products.name: Site-Built Construction Components and Framing Services
products.description: Designs and manufactures roof and floor trusses, wall panels, I-joists, lumber packages, and engineered wood components for residential and light commercial construction, and provides framing services in select markets. Products are produced at company facilities and delivered to builders.

products.name: Custom Commercial Interior Fixtures and Millwork
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and installs highly customized interior fixtures, casework, and architectural millwork for retail and commercial structures, managing programs from concept through completion on a global scale. Products are produced at company facilities and installed at customer sites.

products.name: Concrete Forming Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and supplies wood forms and related products used to set or form concrete for residential, non-residential, distribution, and infrastructure construction. Products are engineered and factory-built for delivery to job sites.

products.name: Wafer Fabrication Equipment (Deposition, Etch, and Clean Systems)
products.description: Physically manufactured and assembled equipment systems for semiconductor wafer processing, including deposition, etch, and clean tools, delivered to semiconductor manufacturers for use in device fabrication lines.

products.name: Advanced Packaging Solutions
products.description: Physically manufactured equipment and process solutions for back-end wafer-level packaging, including fan-out panel-level packaging and 3D stacking of high bandwidth memory, delivered to semiconductor manufacturers for advanced chip packaging applications.

products.name: Customer Support and Equipment Services
products.description: A suite of services including maintenance, upgrades, spare parts, refurbished equipment, and performance optimization, delivered through in-person human labor and digital solutions to maximize the operational efficiency and lifespan of installed wafer fabrication equipment.

products.name: Refurbished and Non-Leading Edge Equipment
products.description: Sales of new and refurbished deposition, etch, and clean equipment for applications that do not require the most advanced wafer processing capability, physically delivered to customers seeking cost-effective or legacy solutions.

products.name: Chicken Wings, Tenders, and Chicken Sandwiches
products.description: Fresh, cooked-to-order bone-in and boneless chicken wings, tenders, and chicken sandwiches, hand-sauced-and-tossed in a variety of proprietary flavors, prepared in physical restaurant locations for dine-in, carryout, or delivery.

products.name: Franchise Restaurant Operations
products.description: Granting franchise rights and providing operational support, training, and brand standards to independent operators who run Wingstop-branded restaurants under strict guidelines, in exchange for franchise fees, royalties, and advertising contributions.

products.name: Side Dishes and Beverages
products.description: Preparation and sale of complementary side items such as seasoned fries, hand-cut carrots and celery, ranch and bleu cheese dips, and branded beverages, served alongside main menu items in restaurants or for takeout/delivery.
